page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2i family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, providing 8 dedicated virtual central processing units (vCPUs). The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, which equates to a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type operates on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units (GPUs). For external connectivity, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. It does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this compute-optimized hardware profile is structured for workloads requiring higher processing density relative to memory capacity. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent execution performance. It is suited for tasks such as web serving, batch processing, and lightweight application hosting where local storage is not a prerequisite.
